invariants.rationale: The method has completed successfully and 'result' represents the write metadata from the commit, so it should not be null at method exit.
The list of write statuses in the result should be non-null after commit to represent the commit result details.
The list size cannot be negative; it can be empty or have elements representing write statuses.
Each write status element in the list is expected to be non-null since it represents write operations in the commit.
Each write status should contain a non-null statistic object after the commit operation.
